name: Deposit
description: A transaction that records one or more deposits into an asset account, either by linking funds previously held in the Undeposited Funds account (via Line.LinkedTxn) or as new direct deposits (via Line.DepositLineDetail).

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: DepositToAccountRef
fields.description: Identifies the account to be used for this deposit. Reference an Account where AccountType is Other Current Asset or Bank.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Account.Id of the referenced account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Account.Name of the referenced account.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items comprising the deposit. Specify a Line.LinkedTxn element along with DepositLine detail type to record a deposit for an existing transaction. Valid Line types include: LinkedTxn and DepositLine.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: The line item identifier.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: The type of line detail. Valid value: DepositLineDetail.

attributes.name: ProjectRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Project associated with the line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Project.Id of the referenced project.

attributes.name: LinkedTxn
attributes.description: Linked transaction(s) funding the deposit. Possible linked transaction types include Transfer, Payment, SalesReceipt, RefundReceipt, JournalEntry.

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: Transaction Id of the linked object.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: Transaction type of the linked object (e.g. Payment, SalesReceipt).

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: Line Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: DepositLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for a direct deposit line.

attributes.name: AccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the account for this deposit line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Account.Id of the referenced account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Account.Name of the referenced account.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied. Not applicable to US companies; required for non-US companies (conditionally required).

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the transaction are expressed. Conditionally required: must be defined if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. Maps to the Memo field on the Invoice form.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home currency units it takes to equal one unit of currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: A reference to a Department object specifying the location of the transaction. Available if location tracking is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Department.Id of the referenced department.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Department.Name of the referenced department.

fields.name: TxnSource
fields.description: Used internally to specify originating source of a credit card transaction.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. For posting transactions, this is the posting date. Defaults to the current server date if not supplied.

fields.name: CashBack
fields.description: Cash back information for the deposit (CashBackInfo).

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Provides information for taxes charged on the transaction as a whole, capturing sales taxes calculated based on the tax codes referenced by the transaction.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Set by Data Services and read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction template the Deposit was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced recurring transaction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced recurring transaction.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction, including all charges, allowances, and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks business logic.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the home currency. Calculated by QuickBooks business logic; valid only when CurrencyRef is specified and multicurrency is enabled.
